title: Synthetic network-societies pilot statements
description: Campaign-local synthetic statements for the four-family network-societies pilot. They are not accepted real Conceptspace seed content.
notes: Synthetic campaign only. Do not copy these into seed-content/.

groups.title: Crypto-friendly merchant trials in Owen Sound

statements.text: I want a business in Grey County, Ontario, to be able to take a blockchain payment from a customer who asks to pay that way.
I want shops in Grey County to refuse customer payments in crypto.
I want a willing shop and a willing customer in Grey County to be able to complete a payment when a bank has blocked that customer.

groups.title: Shared civic life in Grey County

statements.text: I want newcomers in Grey County, Ontario, to be able to learn practical English, and to learn how the library, the bus, a school meeting, and a township office work.
I want newcomers and long-time residents in Grey County to take on practical work together in the county's public places.
I want township business in Grey County to stay in English, including when language classes are offered.
I want newcomers in Grey County to be able to keep their own language communities without a public program that expects them to adopt local customs.
I want Grey County to stop recruiting more newcomers until the published housing and clinic wait times get shorter.
I want practical-English classes in Grey County to stop short of telling newcomers which customs to keep.

groups.title: Christian teaching resources in Grey County

statements.text: I want a Grey County congregation to be able to reuse another congregation's teaching notes.
I want a Grey County church to be able to have a substitute preacher when the regular preacher is away.
I want shared Grey County teaching notes to name the confession they come from.
I want congregations that reuse the same Grey County teaching notes to stop short of publishing a joint statement of doctrine.
I want to help transcribe public civic materials in Grey County, and I do not want that work to include church teaching.
I want a congregation's teaching notes to stay inside that congregation.
I want Grey County families who teach their children at home to have teaching materials they can reuse.
I want a Grey County home-teaching unit to say which teaching method it uses.
I want a Grey County science unit that contains no religious claims, so a secular home-school family can use it.
I want families whose children attend school in Grey County to be allowed to use the same home-teaching materials.
I want children in Grey County taught in staffed schools, and I do not want public rooms booked for home-school programs.

groups.title: Goods reused across Grey County boards

statements.text: I want a person in Grey County, Ontario, who will host a small class to be findable, and I want that person's affiliation written down.
